name: Garaggakal

perception.note: Darkvision, emotion sense (imprecise) 60 feet, sense through

languages: Garaggakal, Can't speak any language, Telepathy 100 feet

generalAbilities.name: Emotion Sense
generalAbilities.description: The garaggakal senses all creatures that are under emotion effects as an imprecise sense at the listed range.

generalAbilities.name: Sense Through
generalAbilities.description: The garaggakal's imprecise senses function through most materials and walls. The senses are blocked by energy fields (such as force fields and force effects) and sufficiently dense material: 10 feet of wood or plastic, 5 feet of stone, 1 foot of common metal, or 6 inches of lead or any starmetal.

defensiveAbilities.name: No Breath
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

The monster doesn't breathe and is immune to effects that require breathing.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draining Saliva
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature that takes damage from a garaggakal's spit Strike must attempt a DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw save. On a failure, it's Drained 1 (or Drained 2 on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Leech Life
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements A living creature within 30 feet of the garaggakal has the drained condition

Effect The garaggakal amplifies the drain on the required creature's essential life force, dealing 5d6 Void Damage damage (Basic DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw save). The garaggakal gains temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt that last 1 minute. Regardless of the result of the save, the garaggakal then Flies up to 15 feet closer to the required creature, and the required creature becomes temporarily immune to Leech Life for 24 hours.

offensiveAbilities.name: Phase Through
offensiveAbilities.description: A garaggakal can shift out of phase with reality and thus can't be held by walls or cages. The garaggakal moves through up to 15 feet of solid matter. They must end their turn outside of the solid matter or take 5d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage. A garaggakal can't phase through force effects.
